item.title: About me
item.description: I am a PhD student at UTokyo, supervised by Prof. Tomonari Sei and Prof. Takeru Matsuda. My interest covers statistics and operations research. I was previously a research associate at UTokyo Hospital, where I developed the first Japanese medical LLM. 🔥 News Feb. 2026 🎉 Our paper was accepted in Neural Computation! Dec. 2025 🎉 Our paper was accepted in ACM Multimedia Asia 2025 Workshop! Oct. 2025 🎉 Two papers were accepted in IJCNLP-AACL 2025 Main conference!
